packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-24 - unverified image-only reading (first reader)

Exposure: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this record. I did not open packet.json.

LAYOUT SURVEY (from overviews image-001.jpg and image-006.jpg)

image-001.jpg: two small parchment fragments laid side by side on black, scale bar left, colour card top right. Each fragment roughly 7-8 cm wide x 12 cm high (scale bar). Both brown, worn, abraded; text very faded at overview resolution. Grey redaction boxes (shelfmark labels?) at top of left fragment and on left edge of right fragment.
 - Left fragment (image-001): single block of text visible, small script, red strokes (rubrics or red touched capitals / paragraph marks) scattered down the face, one small blue mark mid-height. Lower left area red letters near the foot. Black adhesive/glue residue stains at upper right edge and right side.
 - Right fragment (image-001): text appears as a narrow column / list-like layout with short lines, possibly a column of text whose right part is lost, or a list. A larger written word near lower left ("Sp..."?, a heading or enlarged word) at ~24 cm height. Red strokes near the lower right.
image-006.jpg: the other faces of the same two fragments (presumably reverse sides), mirror order. Heavier damage: white patches (paper/abrasion or adhesive residue) across both.
 - Left fragment (image-006): text with red paragraph marks/strokes; a large red initial (looks like "P" or "D", lombard) at the foot right; red letters at foot left ("N" ?). Black glue stains at left edge.
 - Right fragment (image-006): dense text with red marks (paragraph signs / rubric strokes) on several lines; a red letter near upper middle.
Observations only; whether these are two leaves or two parts of one leaf, and which face is recto, is not determinable from the overviews.

Tiles: image-002..005 are native-resolution tiles of the image-001 face set; image-007..010 of the image-006 face set. Mapping noted per tile below.

---------------------------------------------------------------
image-002.jpg  (tile: upper part of the LEFT fragment of the image-001 face; grey redaction box over the top margin; right edge of the right fragment visible at far right)
Observations: surface severely abraded; ink almost entirely lost below the first two written lines. Vertical ruling line visible near the left edge (x~80). Red horizontal strokes (rubric underlinings or red fill-strokes) at line 1 centre (x~480-600), at x~360-500 y~780, x~700-800 y~905, and a red mark at left x~80-130 y~925 and x~180-210 y~740 (red paragraph/initial stroke). Small black marks/glue stains at right edge. Faint traces of text lines run across the whole width but individual letters are not resolvable even with crops (crop-01.jpg: blue channel equalized - too noisy; crop-02.jpg: green channel, top two lines x2).
Script: small gothic book hand (textualis), dark brown ink where it survives; minims and a 2-shaped r / round r visible in line 1.

image-002 line 1 (y~285):  pn[?]ipme' [?] ... (red stroke over/under 2-3 letters) ... -n[?]is  -- first word read as "p(ri)n(c)ipi(u)m'?" is NOT secure; letters seen: p, a minim group, i?, p, m/in, e/c with superscript stroke. Only "...ipme/ipiu(m)?" and final "-nis?" seen.
image-002 line 2 (y~350):  [illegible] ... (traces: "...ett(?) ...") [illegible]
image-002 lines 3-ca.14: [illegible - ink abraded; only isolated strokes and red marks visible]
---------------------------------------------------------------
image-003.jpg  (tile: upper ~2/3 of the RIGHT fragment of the image-001 face; grey redaction box lower left)
Observations: two column areas. (a) A column whose line ENDS survive, ragged/right-justified at about x~900-930; the beginnings of these lines (left of x~450) are abraded away, so it reads like a list but is probably the right-hand end of a text column. (b) To the right of a blank intercolumn (x~950-1120), faint traces of a second column begin at x~1130 running off the right edge (only first letters, e.g. at y~130, 290, 450, 520, 620, 700, 770, 830, 935). About 17-18 lines in the tile height (line spacing ~50 px). Red horizontal strokes in col (a) at y~215 (x~650-740), y~460 (x~660-720), y~510 (x~660-740), y~868 (x~905-990, in intercolumn/line end); small red sign (paragraph mark or red letter) at x~895 y~420. Pricking/sewing holes at left edge x~315 (y~410, y~540) joined by a thread trace. Crops crop-03.jpg (blue channel), crop-04.jpg (lower half, blue), crop-05.jpg / crop-06.jpg (colour stretch): enhancement mostly amplified noise; the unprocessed tile was as legible as any crop. crop-04 and crop-06 were made but not viewed.
Script: same small textualis; ink faded to light brown.

Column (a), line ends only (line numbers counted from top of tile; left part of each line lost):
image-003 l.1 (y~100):  ... [illegible] t' quod? [?]e[?] ... -bus?
image-003 l.2 (y~145):  ... [illegible] -a? (a tall ascender crossing at x~545 belongs to l.1-2)

Assessment: every one of these is a guess at 1-3 final letters; none is secure. No connected text could be read on this tile.
Column (b): only isolated first-letter traces; [illegible].
---------------------------------------------------------------

Observations: same abraded surface; full-width single block of text (no intercolumn seen on this fragment in either tile), approx. 18-19 lines visible in this tile. Red strokes (rubric underlining or red-touched letters) at: y~5 (x~380-500), y~80 (x~525, a short red vertical), y~130 (x~700-800), y~150 (x~75-140, at line start), y~320 (x~490, red vertical), y~460 (x~420-500), y~575 (x~760-800), y~600 (x~95-160, line start), y~705 (x~375-470), y~715 (x~105-170, line start), y~815 and y~880 (x~800-940, line ends), y~940 (foot). A red enlarged initial (2-line high, x~365-470, y~750-880), outline only (faded fill?); shape like an arch with two legs - possibly a lombard A, M or N; not identifiable. Red strokes at line starts (x~75-170) look like paragraph marks / red-touched initials beginning entries.
Text: only isolated letter-groups catch the eye; no word could be read with confidence.
image-004 l.8 (y~345):  [?]e/ex . (x~40-200: 'qu'?/ 'ex'?) ... (x~240-430) "me(?)ns?" / "mens'?" ... [illegible]

All other lines: [illegible].
---------------------------------------------------------------
image-005.jpg  (tile: lower part of the RIGHT fragment of the image-001 face; overlaps image-003 - its lines at y~0-210 are image-003 lines ~15-18 (y~750-960); grey redaction box over upper left; foot of fragment at y~940)
Observations: continues column (a) with ragged line ends at x~930-950; left parts of lines abraded (some line beginnings survive faintly from x~430 lower down, and from x~300 near the foot where the fragment widens). Column (b) at far right: first letters of lines at x~1190-1260 (y~150, 205, 260, 500, 710) - [illegible]. Red strokes at y~92 (x~900-990), y~448 (x~960-1035, line end), y~903 (x~675-830). One line at y~620 written in much darker ink and slightly larger, reaching left to x~520 (in the image-001 overview this looked like an enlarged word); it could be re-inked or a heading-like line; I cannot tell which. Crop crop-07.jpg (x430-1000, y280-780 at 1.8x, colour autocontrast).

Column (a):
image-005 l.1 (y~25):   ... [illegible] -ul/-ad? (overlap with image-003)
image-005 l.2 (y~78):   ... -ce? s(?)... ; red stroke at line end
image-005 l.3 (y~135):  ... -rd / -ad?

image-005 l.10 (y~490): ... "[?]f(?) eto?" / "...Rel(?)e?" - letters "M/R", "e", "l/t", "o/e"
image-005 l.11 (y~540): ... "...in?" 
image-005 l.12 (y~620, dark ink): "...a? l[?] [?]rat' q;"  i.e. visible letters: a(?) l / t, then a word read as "...rar(?)it'" or "...rat'" with a superscript stroke, then a q with a long descender and a hooked mark crossing it (q(ue) or q(uod)? abbreviation). Uncertain throughout; I do NOT read "Spiritus" or any heading word with confidence.
image-005 l.13 (y~670): "[?]ne' ... [?]lia? [?]i(?)"

image-005 l.15 (y~765): [illegible]
image-005 l.16-18 (y~820-910): [illegible]; red stroke at y~903.
Column (b): [illegible].

FACE 1 (image-001 set) SUMMARY: severely abraded; no connected span of even two words is secure. The text block layout: left fragment = a single wide written area with red paragraph strokes and a 2-line red initial near the foot; right fragment = end of one column (ragged line ends) + start of a second column after an intercolumn space. If both fragments belong to the same face of one leaf, the left fragment would need its own column structure; I could not see an intercolumn on the left fragment, so I cannot say how they relate.
===============================================================
FACE 2 (image-006 set)
---------------------------------------------------------------
image-007.jpg  (tile: upper part of the LEFT fragment of the image-006 face; grey redaction box at top; left edge of the right fragment at far right)
Observations: left strip (x~50-190) covered with a crackled, whitish residue (paste/paper remains from a binding); black stains (glue) along x~60-280. White abraded patches lower centre and lower right (y~650-980). Written area x~200-980; faint text lines at ~45-50 px spacing, about 15 lines. Red strokes: y~300 (x~420-480, faint), y~340 (x~530-620, bright red, word underlining or red letter stroke), y~695 (x~580-620), y~850 (x~170-220, red at line start, under the paste). Crop crop-08.jpg (x250-990, y230-660, 1.4x colour autocontrast) added nothing.

image-007 l.? (y~570): (x~280-420) "...ab? mo(?)do?" ; (x~520-620) "ho(?)d?" - none secure
All other lines: [illegible]. No connected text.
---------------------------------------------------------------
image-008.jpg  (tile: upper ~2/3 of the RIGHT fragment of the image-006 face)
Observations: dense single text block from x~300 to the right edge (~1250); lines ~50 px apart, about 18 lines in the tile. Left strip x~270-560 darkened/stained and abraded (paste residue); white flaking patches across centre and right (losses of surface, with paper/fibre showing). Sewing/pricking holes at x~290 y~160 and x~1205 y~410-540 (with thread trace). A red letter/sign at x~760-800, y~235-330: a red stroke with a horizontal top and a long descender (like a red T or paragraph-mark "r" shape) with a red hairline extending right to x~880 - probably a red initial/paragraph sign at the start of a sentence in mid-line. Red horizontal strokes (rubric underlining or red fill in letters) at y~438 (x~460-600), y~495 (x~930-1020), y~745 (x~600-720), y~880 (x~670-760), y~935 (x~430-580). At the right edge x~1200-1260, y~860-960, there is a pale blue-grey vertical note (pencil? modern) - possibly a later shelf annotation; not read. Crops: crop-09.jpg (x330-1150, y80-520), crop-10.jpg (x330-1150, y500-987), both 1.3x colour autocontrast.
